title: Best Call of Duty Zombies maps
description: Classic and modern zombies maps ranked on atmosphere, easter eggs, layout, and replayability.

comments.text: Mob of the Dead is the greatest zombies map ever made and I will die on that hill. The atmosphere, the story, the easter egg...nothing comes close. Tranzit though? That belongs in F tier.
WHERE ARE THE REST OF THE MAPS?! This ranking is a joke. How do you not have Ascension or Moon in S tier? And no love for Call of the Dead either? This list is incomplete and biased.
